question: What species of turtle was recently reintroduced to the Ganga River after a 30-year absence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Red-Crowned Roofed Turtle.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The endangered Red-Crowned Roofed Turtle was reintroduced to the Ganga River after an absence of 30 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The reintroduction took place in the Haiderpur Wetland Complex along the Ganga in Uttar Pradesh on April 26, 2025.**
 
• 20 Red-Crowned Roofed Turtles were released as part of a conservation effort supported by the Namami Gange Mission.
 
• The turtles were equipped with sonic tags to monitor their movements and ensure their safety.
 
• The goal is to establish a self-sustaining population of this critically endangered species in the Ganga River.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Namami Gange Mission__

 __
 
• Launched by the Government of India to clean and rejuvenate the Ganga River.
 
• A key initiative for environmental conservation and biodiversity restoration in the Ganga basin.
 
 
 
• Red-Crowned Roofed Turtle__
 __
 
• A critically endangered species of turtle that was once native to the Ganga River but had disappeared due to population decline.
 
 
 
• Haiderpur Wetland Complex__
 __
 
• Located along the Ganga River in Uttar Pradesh, it provides an ideal environment for the reintroduction of species like the Red-Crowned Roofed Turtle.
 
 
 
• Sonic Tags__
 
 
• Technology used to monitor the movements and ensure the safety of animals during conservation efforts.
